set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWVWM8ZP57V019JT646QA37N. Add lightweight deterministic performance guardrails for whitening, AR estimation, and dense GLS on representative matrix sizes without making normal PR tests brittle. Acceptance: guardrail entry points are documented; default tests remain fast; JVM-only benchmarks are isolated from shared correctness tests.
set.title: Slice 20: AR/GLS performance guardrails
